title: Le Chatelier's Principle - Temperature Change
body: Consider the equilibrium: N2(g) + 3H2(g) <=> 2NH3(g), delta H = -92 kJ. If the temperature of the system is increased, in which direction will the equilibrium shift and what happens to the value of Kc?
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Chemical Equilibrium
